comparisonProtocol.scope: Frozen geometry/material code with the same current renderer, lighting and articulated state; no previous renderer claim.

displayScope: Visible exterior and two-front-seat public cabin study. Public trim photographs are not one measured factory configuration. lightingRevision: 3.9 light rig retained; studio .72 / daylight .68, exposure .92; 3.11 receiver-plane shadow comparison

shadowComparison.mechanism: Per-tap projected receiver-depth correction; derivatives evaluated before light branches
shadowComparison.limits: First-order receiver plane; silhouette/depth discontinuities and curved geometry still require a small normal/depth bias and rendered inspection.
